params.body:
Part of Trendwolves/gentells-studio#82 (the Studio screen closes it; merge this first).

## Why

A report is written and designed outside the Studio. Its sources arrived as whatever was pasted from the web, and Gentells first saw them printed in the uploaded PDF, often as a bare home page. Holding them was a run on the server from a plan someone else prepared, so every report came back with the same repair.

## What changes

`packages/core/report-source-list.mjs`, with five routes for the Studio:

- `POST /reports/:slug/source-list/check {text}`: each pasted line against Gentells, nothing written. A line is in Gentells already, new (the page is read once, so its title, publisher and date show), unreadable (it can still be held once it is named), a home page only (refused), a source read for inspiration only (refused), twice in the paste, or without an address.
- `POST /reports/:slug/source-list {entries}`: holds them under the report, numbered after what it has, through `citeReports`, the road a plan takes: one signal per page, a held page reused, new publishers to the review queue. A home page, a page already in the list and an entry without a publisher are refused with the reason.
- `GET /reports/:slug/source-list`: the list as held, and as numbered text for the design: publisher, date, title and the address on gentells.com. A source that became inspiration only is named apart and left out of the text.
- `DELETE /reports/:slug/source-list/:n`: takes one off; the later ones move up, so the numbers have no gaps. The signal goes with it only when this report made it and nothing else cites it.
- `GET /reports/source-search?q=`: what Gentells holds, by publisher, title or address, every word; pages an author cited before come first; never an inspiration source.

A report needs its row first (Studio, Reports), not its file.

## Checked

- `test/report-source-list.test.mjs`: 9 tests.
- Full suite 1714 of 1714, `tsc` clean.

## To know

- The search is a `LIKE` over the signals table, not the full-text index, because it has to match publisher and address as well as text. Not measured on the box's table; if it is slow there, it gets an index of its own.
- The check reads each new page once and holding reads it again. Two reads per new source, on purpose: the check writes nothing.
params.title: A report's source list is made in Gentells before the PDF is
